criterion.measurement: maximum cross-track displacement inside an obstacle-centred along-track window, using the first navigation feedback and goal to define the nominal route

positive.command: ros2 launch slam_robot_slam_3d custom_3d_navigation_safety_regression.launch.py scenario:=dynamic-obstacle gui:=false rviz:=false

negative_control.command: ros2 launch slam_robot_slam_3d custom_3d_navigation_safety_regression.launch.py scenario:=dynamic-obstacle obstacle_offset_y:=3.0 gui:=false rviz:=false

limitations: One positive and one negative-control run validate criterion sensitivity, not a statistical navigation distribution.
Gazebo required SIGKILL during positive teardown and exited with SIGSEGV during negative teardown after each verdict; no scoped process remained.
